roleBoundary.rule: Trainer must not manufacture the finished answer for Doré. Doré must diagnose, select weapons, compose, render, compare and revise.

round.name: Editorial Composition Control
round.motionRule: Motion remains subordinate. Do not use motion to conceal unresolved composition.

exercises.instruction: Keep each candidate's identity, copy and basic direction. Recompose visual gravity using grid, span, offset, bleed, negative space and scale. Do not solve by changing palette.
Refine type as architecture: display/body/caption relationships, measure, leading, tracking, line breaks, bilingual hierarchy and optical balance. Typography must carry presence before decoration.
Treat image as a designed participant: focal point, crop, bleed, scale, edge relation, image-text pressure and responsive behavior. Do not replace weak art direction with more images.
Combine the three weapons without visible tool seams. Motion may enter only after the still composition passes its own beauty gate.

architectural-bloom: Ottagono modular grid and controlled break

trainerQuestions: What is the dominant visual gravity and is it intentional?
Which relationship is carrying hierarchy: scale, position, contrast, crop, or empty space?
Is every empty region active composition or merely unused canvas?
Can Doré name the weapon it needs before touching code?
Did the chosen weapon solve a deterministic problem rather than make the page busier?
Does the result remain Living Water and Westside rather than becoming a reference imitation?
Can Doré explain why the revision is better without saying only cleaner, modern, or more polished?

graduation.singleWeapon: Doré selects and controls each weapon intentionally across all four existing candidates.
graduation.coordination: Doré combines weapons without tool signatures or mutual interference.
graduation.transfer: On a later unseen design direction, Doré's first proposal is near-mature without trainer manufacturing the answer.

nextExecution: Doré performs E1 on the existing four candidates. Trainer critiques the resulting rasters; trainer does not author the revised pages.
